evals.prompt: 代码已在预览环境验证完成。沿用 .env.worktree 的 local profile 和 go run CLI，直接交付并关闭正式工单。
evals.expected_output: The skill refuses to reuse preview environment state, requires the host-installed mopheus executable, connects and verifies the default profile against exactly https://dev.mopheus.ai, and stops rather than falling back when the formal CLI or authentication is unavailable.

evals.prompt: 在一个 origin 指向其他 GitHub 仓库的 checkout 中运行 Mopheus 全量交付。
evals.expected_output: The skill keeps enmotech/mopheus as the fixed GitHub target, detects that origin does not identify the canonical repository, and stops before any GitHub, Git, or Mopheus repository-link write instead of deriving a different owner/repo.
